samples.name: prop-bridge-deck
samples.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Supplied Kenney sheets are style guides. Single modular 16x16 world prop for medieval Slavic village. Bridge deck of thick planks running TOP TO BOTTOM (across deck), seamless left and right. Four broad vertical planks fill the central band, reaching left and right edges, transparent above/below. No railing or poles. Square canvas, strict 16x16 logical pixel grid enlarged, each pixel a large solid square. Extremely simple Kenney Tiny Town shapes, three flat warm brown colors. Railing top horizontal beam centered at logical row 5 and supports reach row 14. South-facing top-down three-quarter view, not isometric. Transparent outside wood, no water, ground, shadows or scenery. No gradients, haze, glow, antialiasing, neon fringes, fine texture, text or extra panels.
